answer: Score the jury, not only the judged. When every panel member returns the same modal grade on answers that differ in substance, the panel is one reader wearing several hats, so the network prices the panel as a single voice instead of many. The cheap way to beat that is to clone the grader rather than the answer, and a cloned grader cannot afford the nadir of a missed quorum on a mesa of pending work. Every identity keeps a graded pearl of its own record, and the ledger reads that descent, not the headcount, as the real estate worth paying for.
